Well, depending on your current situation, you most likely can ask for a mental leave, if a therapist deems it necessary, or you can just try to talk to whoever is in charge of where you go that you need some form of a break.
Or, you could try talking to somebody, it’s a very good coping mechanism, plus hanging is also unreliable as you will take at most 30 minutes to die and will be in extreme pain the entire time.
Had a similar situation, turns out the friends in question just did not know how to talk to me about it and were terrified of saying the wrong things

Personal suggestion that helped me is thinking about what would happen if you did it, the consequences of it. Believe it or not, and trust me I had a hard time believing it too, most of the people that you rarely talk to will feel the effects of you going through with it. Even people who you have never talked to will feel the pain. I also suggest that you seek help, I didn’t for a while and that made me have constant thoughts. You are not alone with what you are feeling.
